respondent_criteria.purchase_history: Past year purchaser of dry pasta
respondent_criteria.shopping_responsibility: Primary or shared grocery shopping responsibility

methodology.data_collection: 15-minute web-based / mobile online survey with shopping simulation

study_overview.background: Barilla is a 145-year-old family-owned food company leading the pasta category in the US. Vista Grande conducted this study to develop assortment and merchandising strategies using the Category Choice Architecture® framework.

objectives.who: Understand today's pasta shoppers, emphasizing attitudinal dimensions.
objectives.why: Explore reasons for pasta shopping, focusing on occasions and drivers.
objectives.where: Identify where shoppers go for their pasta needs and why.
objectives.how: Analyze how shoppers want the assortment, focusing on attributes, navigation, and consideration sets.
objectives.what: Understand tradeoffs shoppers are willing to make, emphasizing substitutions.

key_findings.dominance: Dry pasta dominates with 81% of shoppers purchasing it monthly or more.
key_findings.generational_trends: Millennials and Gen Z prefer a broader set of pasta types, including Better-for-You options.

channel_preferences.in_store: Grocery stores account for 62% of shopping trips; Walmart is next at 28%.
channel_preferences.online: 11% of shoppers buy pasta online, driven by convenience and delivery speed.

product_preferences.top_types: Spaghetti (70%), Elbows (54%), and Penne (50%) are the most purchased shapes.
product_preferences.better_for_you: 41% of shoppers purchase Better-for-You pasta monthly or more, including gluten-free and legume-based options.

regional_trends.northeast: Ziti (46%) and Rigatoni (44%) are particularly popular in the Northeast.

retailer_specific_insights.grocery: Grocery shoppers prioritize convenience, competitive pricing, and variety.
retailer_specific_insights.walmart: Walmart shoppers are price-sensitive and value convenience for broader grocery shopping.
retailer_specific_insights.natural: Natural channel shoppers look for organic products and innovative pasta options.

practical_implications.pricing: Price-sensitive shoppers dominate Walmart and Club channels, suggesting competitive promotions.
practical_implications.health_focus: Younger shoppers' preference for health-focused products highlights opportunities for Better-for-You campaigns.
practical_implications.regional_focus: Ziti and Rigatoni are key shapes for regional campaigns in the Northeast.
